applies_why: The judge text evaluates a challenger link as broken using verses but does not count any cited-in verse as an unanswered witness.
quote: D2 vs C3 (Matthew 1:18, 25): CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count.
room: I weighed 'counts as an unanswered witness' as either an express unanswered-witness count or any citation used against a link; the text does not do the former.
why: The rule only governs counting a cited-in verse as an unanswered witness, while this judge text merely marks a challenger link broken, so it does not breach K-G4.
